input.subject: 8 Whitby Row, Ellesford ZZ1 8ZZ – ref R/9 – rent arrears and deposit
input.body:
Dear Landlord,

Thank you for your email about 8 Whitby Row, Ellesford, ZZ1 8ZZ (ref R/9).

The rent arrears and the deposit from the previous tenancy are not maintenance matters, so I have passed your case to a colleague in our lettings team, who will contact you about the next steps.

We cannot arrange a lock change to stop the tenant getting into the property. Changing the locks on someone who still lives there without a court order is likely to be unlawful eviction in England and Wales, and the consequences can be serious. Please do not change the locks or stop the tenant getting in while this is being dealt with. My colleague can talk you through the lawful options for recovering arrears, and how disputes about a deposit can be settled through the deposit protection scheme.

If there is a real repair or security problem at the property, such as a broken lock, please let us know and we will deal with it as a maintenance job.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Operations
